target_customer: Engineering organizations that want to measure engineering output and AI coding spend, from startups to large companies
problem: Leaders cannot tell how much AI coding tools change team speed, quality and cost. Weave builds models that measure engineering work and routes tasks to cost efficient models.
business_model: B2B SaaS for engineering intelligence plus a model router
product_category: engineering analytics and AI coding ROI

founders.name: Adam Cohen
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: operations and sales background, led organizations of 100 plus people, ran sales and customer success at Causal.

founders.name: Andrew Churchill
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: employee number one at Causal.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM based analysis of pull requests and spend across many repositories is standard engineering with hard parts in measurement validity and scale.

defensibility.rationale: Benchmarks across many organizations can compound, but analytics vendors and AI coding tools can add similar dashboards.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent analytics vendors added AI impact dashboards over 2025 and 2026 per comparison articles.

market_need_then: AI coding tool spend was growing fast in early 2025 and executives wanted proof of return, while classic DORA metrics did not capture AI effect.

branding.domain_note: Uses weaveos.com (suffix OS); how it was obtained is not stated.

identity.mascot_or_character: Wooly, a mascot character on its site
identity.visual_style: Terminal style snippets for the router, metrics front and center
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct, for example Turn your software team into a software factory

brand_strength.rationale: A mascot and confident voice on the site show deliberate brand work, but no press or community evidence was found, and many companies share the Weave name.

outcome_analysis: Weave joined YC in Winter 2025 and positioned itself as the measurement layer for AI coding output. It raised a $4.2M seed in 2025 and a $13.5M round reported in July 2026, and its site claims 500 plus customer organizations including Robinhood and PostHog. Growth followed the AI coding spend wave, while analytics incumbents add competing dashboards.
notes: Seed of $4.2M led by Moonfire and Burst Capital is also repeated in the company's own YC job postings and by Sacra; its date is July or August 2025 across sources, so only the year is recorded. The $13.5M July 2026 round: the fetched page confirmed amount, founders and date 2026-07-28 but sits behind a sign in wall; the Series A label and Standard Capital as lead came from a search summary of the article, so treat the stage as lightly sourced. Sacra calls Weave a rival of LinearB, Jellyfish and Span; comparison articles are dated 2026, so no competitor is listed as of founding. The weaveos.com customer and 500 plus organization claims are company statements.
